name: Albury Classic Motor Inn
description: A 26-room motor inn on Wagga Road at Lavington with an outdoor swimming pool, a shaded BBQ area and well-lit courtyard parking. Room types include upstairs and downstairs queen, twin, family (queen bed plus two singles), spa queen and a two-bedroom unit, along with pet friendly queen, twin and family rooms. Rooms have free wireless broadband, reverse cycle air conditioning and kitchenettes with microwaves and bar fridges.
highlights: Kitchenettes with microwave and bar fridge

name: Albury City Motel
description: A 3 star motel on Young Street in central Albury with a pool and spacious air conditioned rooms with en suite bathrooms and kitchenettes. The motel lists reverse cycle air conditioning, microwaves, kettle, toaster, tea and coffee, flat screen TVs, fast free WiFi and free parking. Rooms cater from a single traveller through to a large family or group.

name: Seaton Arms Motor Inn
description: A motor inn on Olive Street that describes itself as quiet, comfortable and conveniently located in the heart of the Albury CBD, steps from shops, restaurants and local attractions. Room types are Standard Queen, Standard Queen with sofa bed, Standard Twin and Twin Queen. Bookings can be made directly through the motel's website.
highlights: Standard queen, twin and twin queen rooms
Queen rooms with sofa bed available
Walking distance to shops and restaurants

name: The Cottage Motor Inn
description: A motor inn in Albury's CBD about a 10 minute walk from the Dean Street dining and entertainment strip, the Albury Botanic Gardens and the Murray River. Room options are Queen, Twin, Family (sleeps 4), Superior Family (sleeps 5), a Twin Room with disability access, and one and two bedroom ground floor apartments. Rooms include reverse cycle air conditioning, free high speed Wi-Fi, a flat-screen smart TV and a kitchenette with bar fridge, and the property has free parking, an EV charger and 24 hour self check-in.
highlights: One and two bedroom ground floor apartments
Free parking and free high speed Wi-Fi

name: Albury Burvale Motor Inn
description: A motel on Young Street offering six room types: Deluxe 2 Bedroom Suite, Deluxe Family, Deluxe Queen, Standard Family, Standard Queen and Standard Economy. Rooms include free WiFi, reverse cycle air conditioning, 50 inch LCD TVs, en-suite bathrooms, microwaves and tea and coffee facilities. Free private parking is available on site and the property has a strict no-party policy.
highlights: Six room types including a two bedroom suite
Microwaves and tea and coffee facilities

name: Allawa Motor Inn
description: An Albury motel with all rooms on the ground floor and direct outdoor parking access. Accommodation is a 20 square metre Queen Room, a 20 square metre Twin Room sleeping up to three adults, and a 50 square metre Apartment with two queen beds and a single sleeping up to five. Each room has either a fully equipped kitchen or a kitchenette, and the property has free WiFi, a swimming pool, free parking and a digital lock system. Select rooms are pet friendly for an additional cost.
highlights: Fully equipped kitchen or kitchenette in each room
Pet friendly rooms available at extra cost

name: Commodore Motor Inn
description: A Kiewa Street motor inn with Superior Twin, Standard Twin, Family, King Deluxe and Deluxe Queen rooms. The motel lists unlimited access to WiFi and free onsite parking for cars, boats, trailers and high vehicles. All rooms have microwaves, and King Deluxe rooms add a coffee espresso machine and a 42 inch smart TV. Check-in is 2pm and check-out 10am.
highlights: Free onsite parking for boats, trailers and high vehicles
King Deluxe rooms with espresso machine

name: Hume Country Motor Inn
description: A motor inn on Logan Road near Nail Can Hill Reserve, described on its site as an oasis between Albury and Wodonga with lush trees and mountain views. Rooms include a 25 square metre Queen Bedroom, a 25 square metre Twin Bedroom, a 30 square metre Executive Spa Suite, plus Family Room 4, Family Room 5 and a Large Family Unit. Facilities are a swimming pool, BBQ area, children's play area, guest laundry, conference facilities, free parking and free Wi-Fi.
highlights: Family rooms and a large family unit

name: Winsor Park Motor Inn
description: A motor inn on Young Street in Albury offering Queen, Twin, Family, Deluxe Queen, Deluxe Family and downstairs Deluxe Twin rooms. An EV charger is available on site for a minimal charge. Reception is open 7:30am to 7:00pm Monday to Saturday and 8:00am to 7:00pm Sunday.
highlights: Six room types including deluxe family
EV charger available for a minimal charge

name: The Hume Inn Motel
description: A motel on Wodonga Place opposite the Murray River, about an 8 minute walk from the Albury city centre. The property has a swimming pool area and garden with barbecue facilities, free WiFi, free parking and flat-screen TVs in rooms. Room types range from Economy Queen and Twin through Deluxe Queen and Twin, a Deluxe Twin with disability access, small and two-bedroom family rooms and a Spa Room. Pets are welcome for $30 per night, with a maximum of two pets per room subject to availability.
highlights: Swimming pool and garden BBQ area
Deluxe twin room with disability access
Two-bedroom family rooms and a spa room

name: BIG4 Albury Tourist Park
description: A holiday park just off the Hume Highway at Lavington, about 300m from Lavington Square. Accommodation covers studio, spa, one, two and three bedroom cabins, accessible two bedroom cabins and powered gravel and drive-through caravan sites. Facilities include a heated outdoor pool, playground and lawn games, undercover BBQ areas, a camp kitchen, free park-wide WiFi, laundry and a dump point. The park also takes corporate and work crew bookings with long-stay rates, and does not accept pets.
highlights: Studio, spa and up to three bedroom cabins
Playground, lawn games and camp kitchen

name: Albury Holiday Park
description: A holiday park on Wagga Road at Lavington offering self-contained cabins, powered caravan sites, grass and gravel camping sites, worker accommodation and affordable rentals. Facilities listed are a swimming pool, playground, free WiFi, BBQ facility, camp kitchen, laundry, dump point, hot showers and shady sites. The park is pet friendly and is promoted as a base for the Murray River region, close to Monument Hill Lookout and the Albury Botanic Gardens.
highlights: Powered caravan and grass camping sites

name: Stagecoach Motel Wodonga
description: A Melbourne Road motel in Wodonga with Executive Queen, Executive Twin, King Suite and King Spa rooms. Rooms feature premium triple sheet linen and private ensuite bathrooms. The property lists free WiFi, air conditioning, an outdoor pool, free parking and BBQ facilities.
highlights: King suite and king spa rooms

name: Motel Wellington Wodonga
description: A High Street motel in central Wodonga, 700m from the Hume Freeway exit and within walking distance of local shops and cafes. Rooms are King, Queen, Twin, Family, Family Apartment and Budget Double, with the 26 square metre queen, twin and family rooms on the ground floor. Each room has a kitchenette with tea, coffee, a microwave and fridge, plus heating and air-conditioning, complimentary WiFi and parking that suits small trucks and trailers. The motel operates 24 hour keyless check-in with digital room codes sent by phone.
highlights: Parking for small trucks and trailers
Walking distance to Wodonga shops and cafes

name: Twin City Motor Inn
description: A Melbourne Road motor inn in Wodonga within walking distance of the Wodonga Tennis Centre and about 2.1km from The Cube Wodonga. Room types are Queen, Small Family, Large Family Unit, Deluxe Double and Deluxe Twin. The property offers free in-room WiFi and is close to the Wodonga Golf Course and Belvoir Park.
highlights: Small family rooms and a large family unit
Close to Wodonga Golf Course and Belvoir Park

name: Blazing Stump Motel & Suites
description: A motel and suites property on Anzac Parade, less than 3km from the heart of Wodonga and roughly 10 minutes from Albury Wodonga Airport. Accommodation includes two-bedroom courtyard apartments, two-bedroom executive spa apartments, a cabin complex, the Envy Apartment, Executive King Suite, Honeymoon Suite, Junior Suite, Twin Queen Suites and easy access suites. On site are a swimming pool, the Embers Dining Room for functions and catering, and the Ashes Boardroom for conferences.
highlights: Ashes Boardroom for conferences and functions
Two-bedroom courtyard and executive spa apartments
About 10 minutes from Albury Wodonga Airport

name: Wodonga Holiday Park
description: A holiday park on McKoy Street, minutes from the Hume Freeway and about three kilometres from the Wodonga town centre. Accommodation is self-contained cabins including two-bedroom superior family cabins, powered slab caravan sites and shaded unpowered camping sites. The park has a swimming pool, BBQ facilities, a playground and a camp kitchen, and describes itself as a friendly, laid-back base for travellers, families, road trippers and grey nomads.

name: Wodonga Caravan & Cabin Park
description: A pet friendly caravan and cabin park on Melbourne Road, two minutes from the Wodonga town centre and ten minutes from Albury. Accommodation is ensuite cabins in various configurations, including easy access cabins, plus powered caravan sites taking vehicles up to 12.19 metres. The park has a playground and BBQ areas and sits close to Wodonga Railway Station, the Tennis Centre, the Sports Leisure Centre, the go-kart centre, the skate park and the golf club.
highlights: Ensuite cabins including easy access cabins
Powered sites for vehicles up to 12.19m
Two minutes from Wodonga town centre

name: Howlong Caravan Park
description: A caravan park in the centre of Howlong near the Murray River, with cabins, villas and grassed powered sites for caravans and campers. The park lists free Wi-Fi, a salt water swimming pool, an undercover BBQ area, gas refills and coin operated laundry facilities. Kayaking on the Murray River can be arranged by booking, subject to availability, and the park is pet friendly. Short-term, long-term and permanent stays are offered, including corporate and workforce accommodation.
highlights: Cabins, villas and grassed powered sites
Gas refills and coin operated laundry
Kayaking on the Murray River by booking

name: Corowa Caravan Park
description: A family owned park described on its site as the only independently owned and operated caravan park in Corowa, set on 12 acres of natural bushland on the banks of the Murray River about 1.4km from the township. Accommodation covers powered and unpowered riverbank sites, non-ensuite studio rooms, one and two bedroom self-contained cabins, family units and workers accommodation by direct enquiry. Facilities include an amenities block, camp kitchen, boat ramp, undercover BBQ area, an in-ground swimming pool and BBQ and picnic areas throughout, and pet friendly options are available at select sites.
highlights: 12 acres of bushland on the Murray River

name: Heritage Motor Inn Corowa
description: A motor inn on Edward Street in central Corowa with Deluxe Queen, Deluxe Twin, Superior Queen, Superior Twin and Superior King rooms, an Executive King Spa, a two bedroom apartment and an executive three bedroom apartment. The site notes dining, EV charging and its central location, with direct booking available through the website.

name: Federation Motel Resort
description: A motel resort on Honour Avenue at Corowa, across the Murray River from the Rutherglen wine district. The property advertises the biggest motel rooms in Corowa, with newly refurbished Standard Family, Executive King and Spa rooms. Facilities are a salt water swimming pool and spa, a guest barbecue in a shady garden area, guest laundry, free wireless internet and ample parking for trailers, large vehicles, buses and boats.
highlights: Salt water swimming pool and spa
Guest BBQ in a shady garden area
Parking for buses, boats and large vehicles
Guest laundry and free wireless internet
Across the river from the Rutherglen wine district

name: Yackandandah Holiday Park
description: A holiday park within walking distance of the historic Yackandandah town centre, offering self-contained cabins plus powered and unpowered camping sites for caravans and tents. Facilities include shower and toilet amenities, a guest laundry, camp kitchen, free BBQs and free WiFi, with linen and towels supplied in cabins. Sites are grassy and shaded, and the park is dog friendly subject to conditions.
highlights: Walking distance to Yackandandah town centre
Self-contained cabins with linen and towels
Powered and unpowered grassy shaded sites

name: Golden Heritage Accommodation
description: Motel and self-contained accommodation on Sydney Road, about two minutes' drive or a 15 minute walk from the Beechworth village centre. Options are Executive King Suites and Deluxe Queen motel rooms, one and two bedroom self-contained spa cottages and two bedroom self-contained apartments. Rooms include free WiFi, quality linen, microwaves, pod coffee machines, LCD smart TVs and heating and air-conditioning, and elevated verandas look over historic Beechworth. EV charging is offered to guests who book direct, and cycling facilities are available.
highlights: Self-contained one and two bedroom spa cottages
Executive king suites and deluxe queen rooms
EV charging for direct booking guests
Pod coffee machines and microwaves in rooms
15 minute walk to the Beechworth village centre

name: Beechworth Cabins
description: Self-contained cabin accommodation on High Street in Beechworth. The cabin has two bedrooms, one with a double bed and one with triple bunks, a bathroom with shower, a lounge area and a kitchenette with a stovetop and full-size refrigerator and freezer. The site describes Beechworth as a rustic escape known for its gold mining heritage, galleries, craft breweries and fine dining.
highlights: Triple bunks in the second bedroom
Kitchenette with stovetop and full-size fridge freezer

name: Beechworth House
description: Guest accommodation on Dingle Road, Beechworth, with three suites named Le Tour, Citron and Jardin. Gourmet dinners are prepared nightly by chef Denis Hagger using food sourced from the on-site gardens, local orchards and direct from growers. A guest program includes complimentary champagne on arrival, daily continental breakfast, a chef's welcome treat and discounted wine selections. The property is dog friendly.
highlights: Gourmet dinners prepared nightly on site
Produce from on-site gardens and local orchards

name: The Inn Beechworth
description: Three self-contained cottages for short-term accommodation in Beechworth. Kelly House is a restored 1890s property with three bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, soft European linens and an open fire. Picketts Cottage is a smaller cottage for two with a clawfoot tub and a cosy lounge, and Ned's Nook is a studio suited to solo travellers or couples. The properties are described as having old-world character with modern comforts, and pets are welcome.
highlights: Restored 1890s Kelly House with three ensuite bedrooms
Picketts Cottage with a clawfoot tub
Ned's Nook studio for solo travellers or couples

name: Rutherglen Country Cottages
description: A bed and breakfast run by hosts Alister and Heather Chisholm, with entry via the rear on Murray Street opposite the golf course. GumTree Cottage has one bedroom with a queen bed, ensuite, air conditioning and a separate living area, and Garden Cottage has two bedrooms with two queen beds, ensuite, air conditioning and two separate toilets. Guests have a swimming pool and an alfresco area with BBQ, fridge, fire and television, and breakfast is included. The cottages are a five minute walk to the shopping centre, restaurants and pubs, adjacent to an 18-hole golf course and near the 1.2km walking track around Lake King.
highlights: Alfresco area with BBQ, fridge and fire
Five minute walk to Rutherglen shops and restaurants

name: Motel Woongarra
description: A motel on Drummond Street about 0.5km from the Rutherglen town centre and around 30 minutes' drive from Albury Wodonga. Room types are Supreme King, Supreme Queen, Twin and Family Suite, all spacious ground floor rooms with smart televisions, reverse cycle air conditioning, microwave, bar fridge, kettle, toaster and iron. The property has an outdoor swimming pool, a BBQ area with outdoor seating, free on-site parking and free WiFi, and a high chair and portable cot are available on request.
highlights: Family suite with high chair and cot on request
Free on-site parking and free WiFi

name: The Gatta Inn
description: A motel on the shores of Lake Hume at Tallangatta, formerly trading as the Tallangatta Motor Inn. It positions itself as a bike friendly motel and is developing cycling amenities including secure bike storage, repair stations and cycling route maps for guests. Bike shuttle services to scenic trailheads are offered, equipped to carry multiple bikes and bookable one-way or return. The office is open 10am to 5pm and online booking is available.
highlights: Secure bike storage and repair stations
On the shores of Lake Hume
